goal: Prevent players from reading unrevealed world and NPC fields through authenticated APIs.

cases.expect: Only spoiler-free metadata or no access; never hidden ids, titles or full bodies.
No private body; only facts committed and disclosed to that player.
Authorized with separate administrator credential, revisioned and auditable.
Server can see hidden world facts but cannot return them in player payload.
Does not include hidden content or unrevealed facts.
Only revealed public consequence after event commit; no hidden trigger conditions.

notes: Authenticated does not imply administrator: user must be able to play without seeing spoilers.
Enforce server-side roles and field-level filtering, not only UI hiding.
Test negative access to content before importing any real story.
Use synthetic fictional-free fixtures; never commit real story payloads.
